criteria: Established patient office visit; requires documented chief complaint, history, exam, and medical decision making.
outcome_guidance: Approve. No prior authorization required at this level.

criteria: High-complexity office visit; requires documentation supporting high complexity MDM or >30 minutes counseling.
outcome_guidance: Approve only if documentation supports high complexity; otherwise downgrade to 99214.

criteria: MRI cervical spine without contrast; requires >= 6 weeks failed conservative therapy or documented red flags (progressive neurologic deficit, trauma, malignancy history).
outcome_guidance: Approve if conservative therapy failure or red flags are documented; otherwise request clinical attestation.

criteria: MRI lumbar spine without contrast; same conservative therapy / red-flag criteria as CR-003.
outcome_guidance: Approve with citation to POL-102 when criteria met; deny if imaging requested < 6 weeks into symptoms without red flags.

criteria: Infusion of non-formulary chemotherapy agent; requires formulary exception, pathology report, and line-of-therapy documentation.
outcome_guidance: Escalate: deny pending completion of prior authorization packet per POL-103.

criteria: In-lab polysomnography; requires STOP-BANG >= 3 or ESS >= 11 plus prior inconclusive home sleep test.
outcome_guidance: Approve when screening scores and prior HST result documented; otherwise direct to home sleep testing first (POL-104).

criteria: High-complexity physical therapy evaluation; requires plan of care and measurable functional deficits.
outcome_guidance: Approve up to 12 visits per condition per calendar year per POL-105.
